summary: Selected startups with 20 or fewer employees can receive $10,000 in Voice Agent Platform credits for up to six months. Teams worldwide may apply; voice must be a core product capability, not a secondary feature. The program prioritizes leading-accelerator teams, early-stage venture-backed companies and exceptional bootstrapped founders. If grant credits run out within six months, continued use requires purchasing additional Pay as you go credits. After six months, startups can transition to a paid Pay as you go or Custom Pricing plan.
claim_steps: Confirm the startup has 20 or fewer employees and voice is a core product capability; worldwide teams and exceptional bootstrapped founders may apply.
Create a Smallest.ai account if needed.
Submit the grant application with company, product, team, and voice-AI usage details.
If selected, credits are applied to the account email supplied in the application.
If grant credits run out within six months, purchase additional Pay as you go credits to continue using the service.
After six months, continued use can transition to a paid Pay as you go or Custom Pricing plan.
